form.title: Add a large-text guide
form.summary: Enter the fields below. Examples show what to enter.

fields.label: Guide title
fields.hint: Enter the name you want to see in the answer.

fields.label: Publication date
fields.hint: Enter your demo publication date. CQ6 sorts newest first.

fields.label: Alzheimer's symptom
fields.hint: Choose a symptom already linked to Alzheimer's, for example MemoryLoss.

fields.label: Audience
fields.hint: Choose an older-adult audience, for example MaryOlderAdult.

fields.label: Dementia type
fields.hint: Choose AlzheimerType for this Alzheimer's question.

fields.label: Supports large text
fields.hint: Choose True so the guide meets CQ6's large-text requirement.
